The Shapley terms from the three modalities and a small layout residual sum to the region’srr.(c)Change in modality contribution from the frozen to the adapted model. Audio contribution increases the most, while text falls.(d)Share of the prediction carried from each stimulus modality (left) to the backbone’s output at each modality’s tokens (right), which is the readout’s input. Crossing ribbons are cross-modal mixing within the backbone, which nearly doubles after adaptation.
